answer: Gate every job through a narrow inlet: work is assigned by a verifiable lottery where each identity's tickets grow only with audited, delivered work, never with headcount. A raven-black market of fake identities holds almost no tickets combined, so a Sybil farm's expected income stays near zero while each fake still pays a registration bond. Honest agents earn more tickets with every verified voyage of completed work, making one real reputation worth far more than a thousand empty shells.
